novel_features.name: Offers analytics by category
novel_features.description: Group your synced card-linked offers by category to see at a glance where the bulk of your enrollable rewards live (Dining, Travel, Shopping, etc.).
novel_features.rationale: The American Express hub endpoint returns one flat list per request. Grouping requires either client-side parsing every call or a local store; this CLI's sync persists offers into SQLite so analytics composes without re-hitting the rate-limited live API.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets an agent answer 'which category has the most offers I haven't enrolled in yet' in one call instead of pulling and tallying the live list itself.

novel_features.name: Watch for new card-linked offers
novel_features.description: Poll the offers hub at a chosen interval and emit NDJSON change events when an offer is added, expires, or flips between available and enrolled.
novel_features.rationale: AMEX issues new offers continuously and does not expose a webhook or push channel. Without local diffing, a user only ever sees the current snapshot; the local store lets the CLI compute and emit a true changelog.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Gives an agent a streaming hook to react to new statement-credit offers without having to schedule its own diffing job.

novel_features.name: Offline archive of all offers
novel_features.description: Snapshot every available and enrolled offer into the local SQLite store in one command, so subsequent reads and analytics work offline and at zero rate-limit cost.
novel_features.rationale: The hub endpoint is cookie-authenticated and rate-limited. Archiving once means downstream filtering, grouping, and SQL queries run against the local store rather than burning live requests.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets an agent run a tight loop of `--data-source local` queries against the offer set without repeatedly hitting the live AMEX hub.
